metadata.title: Steamed Tapioca Leaves | Northeastern Cuisine
metadata.description:
Seamed tapioca leaves are a rustic Northeastern delicacy which is very simple to prepare and is delicious. Tender leaves are rolled inside banana leaf along with onion, chilies and some seasoning to prepare this dish. 
The resulting dish from this very simple process has a strong earthy flavor, which leaves you craving for more.
